operating_notes.text: Anupam Rasayan agreed to buy 43.30% of Bliss GVS Pharma from identified sellers at ₹299 a share, with a call option on a further 4.90%, plus a 26% open offer at the same price.
Bliss GVS Pharma's consolidated turnover was ₹1,000.64 Cr in FY26, ₹846.22 Cr in FY25 and ₹798.98 Cr in FY24, with net worth of ₹1,231.76 Cr at March 31, 2026.
Deputy CFO and KMP Vishal Thakkar resigned with immediate effect after four years, to explore other opportunities within the Group with an option to work in his own company; no successor named.
Order book of LOIs and contracts totals ₹14,646 Cr.
Bliss GVS Pharma FY26: revenue ₹927 Cr, EBITDA ₹164 Cr (18% margin), PAT ₹135 Cr, cash flow from operations ₹139 Cr, cash & equivalents ₹167 Cr and zero net debt as on 31 March 2026.
Bliss GVS runs 6 manufacturing facilities in Palghar, Vevoor and Ambernath with installed capacity of 4,822 mn units and current utilisation of only 30%.
Bliss GVS capex: Vevoor plant ₹260 Cr, Palghar suppositories ₹50 Cr, Vevoor ointment ₹40 Cr; pipeline of 62+ molecules, 48+ for regulated markets.
₹160 Cr NCDs carry a 10.25% coupon, 13-month tenor, minimum security cover of 250% and are secured by a pledge of 31,50,000 promoter-held shares.
Agrochemical segment contributed 55%, Pharma 20%, Performance Materials 18%, and Personal Care 7% of FY26 standalone revenue.
India Ratings maintained ratings on Watch with Negative Implications pending clarity on capital structure for Bliss GVS acquisition.
Order book of LOIs and contracts totals ₹17,496 Cr, with the largest single item a ₹3,000 Cr battery chemical LOI with Elementium signed in Q4FY25.
International business was 36% of revenue in Q1FY27.
Total installed capacity is 2,00,552 MT across Anupam, Tanfac and Jayhawk plants.

timeline.summary: Anupam Rasayan India Limited’s postal ballot resolutions passed via e-voting on May 07, 2026, with 43,799 shareholders on record.

Anupam Rasayan India Ltd. scheduled an earnings call for May 25, 2026, at 05:30 PM IST to discuss Q4 & FY26 results, featuring Managing Director Anand Desai, CEO Gopal Agrawal, CFO Amit Khurana, and DCFO Vishal Thakkar.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹635.78 Cr (+27.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹42.65 Cr (-4.3% YoY).
Anupam Rasayan approved the acquisition of up to 74.20% stake and control in Bliss GVS Pharma for up to ₹2,198.54 Cr via a share purchase agreement and open offer.
2026-05-23: Deputy CFO and KMP Vishal Thakkar resigned with immediate effect to explore other opportunities within the Group; no successor named.
Anupam Rasayan's Q4 & FY26 investor presentation reported FY26 revenue of ₹2,384 Cr (+26% YoY) and PAT of ₹222 Cr (+39%), with EBITDA margin at 23%.

2026-05-23: Anupam Rasayan's investor presentation detailed the Bliss GVS Pharma acquisition — 43.3-48.2% plus open offer, funded by a ~₹300 Cr term loan and a non-voting instrument; Bliss GVS FY26 revenue ₹927 Cr, PAT ₹135 Cr, zero net debt.
Ashish Gupta announced the earnings call recording for Q4 FY 2025-26 audited results, available on May 25, 2026, via www.anupamrasayan.com.
2026-05-26: Anupam Rasayan allotted ₹160 Cr of 13-month, 10.25% unlisted NCDs to Aditya Birla Capital, secured by a pledge of 31.5 lakh promoter shares, for debt repayment and group investment.
Anupam Rasayan reported FY26 revenue of ₹2,384 Cr (+65% YoY) and announced a definitive agreement to acquire a 43.3% to 48.2% stake in Bliss GVS Pharma.
2026-06-03: Crisil placed Anupam Rasayan's ratings on watch with developing implications and assigned Crisil A+ to ₹160 Cr NCDs.
India Ratings maintained Anupam Rasayan's ratings on Rating Watch with Negative Implications and assigned ratings to new bank loans and NCDs.
Anupam Rasayan reported Q1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹655 Cr, up 35% YoY, with PAT up 6% to ₹51 Cr, and disclosed a ₹17,496 Cr order book of LOIs and contracts.
